Open the pull request against dollspace-gay/Thermite. Branch from an upstream ref rather than the fork's main, so the process layer stays out of the diff. One PR per RFC, one commit per RFC so the revision derives from git, and never squash-merge an RFC PR or the review history collapses.

```day-atom
{"in":["trust-statement","design-doc"],"out":["upstream-pr"],"next":[]}
```

Scoped and implemented the in-tree kernel removal as issue #10 -> branch chore/move-kernel-out (cut from upstream/main at 84d276e7) in the staging fork. The premise checked out against evidence rather than memory: dollspace-gay/Thermite-Microkernel pins Thermite at commit b8dc3947, the EXACT PARENT of 84d276e7, plus the v0.0.2 baseline 845d684f, and a code search across its 173 files returns zero hits for thermite-kernel, x86_64-pc-uefi-smp-v1 or bootable_kernel. Its own .th sources write only fx pure. So the real microkernel consumes Thermite as a toolchain (forge build --level l3 --target kernel --export, exact-source codegen, closure and TV gates, VerifiedBuildReceiptV1, verify-build --replay) and deliberately sits one commit before the in-tree kernel. The second home is dollspace-gay/AethelOS. Boundary: 84d276e7 added 38 files and modified 87; remove the additions, keep the modifications. One correction found while implementing: the fx platform(...) effect atom and its closed 12-domain PlatformDomain enum were also added by that commit, live in MODIFIED files (17 references in thermite-lower/src/effects.rs alone), and have no consumer once the in-tree kernel goes - so they go too, which returns the effect algebra to exactly the b8dc3947 shape every downstream pin already builds against.

doc-drift on this tree is a whole-repo tripwire, not a per-file one, and a removal trips it far wider than the files it deletes. Removing the in-tree kernel touched shared files - thermite-syntax/{ast,parser}.rs, thermite-lower/{effects,lower}.rs, forge/{cli,manifest,vacuity,verified_build}.rs, thermite-verified/src/lib.rs, Cargo.toml, THERMITE.skill.md - and audited-content-sha256 is computed over each doc's whole governed SET, so 29 design docs drifted, most of which have nothing to do with kernels (.design/basis/*, .design/syntax/{ast,parser}.md, .design/lower/verus-lowering.md). Establishing fault first mattered and nearly went wrong twice. First I ran the gate through a pipe - 'cmd | tail' - and read exit 0 when the real exit was 1, the exact error the practice claim records. Then I ran the baseline on the git-archive export and got exit 3, INCONCLUSIVE, because doc-drift needs a real .git; reading that as 'baseline is clean' would have charged 29 pre-existing drifts to this change. A worktree at 84d276e7 exits 0 with 0 drift, so all 29 are ours and all 29 are re-pinned with a dated note keeping the prior digest. Two gates also disagree about ordering: renaming forge/tests/kernel_target.rs left three REQ evidence paths dangling, which req-registry --check caught only AFTER doc-drift was already green, and fixing it re-drifted the doc that governs the registry.

SHIPPED: issue #10 -> branch chore/move-kernel-out -> PR #11 in the staging fork, one commit cut from upstream/main at 84d276e7, 99 files, +229/-14550. The premise was verified against evidence rather than accepted: Thermite-Microkernel pins b8dc3947 (the exact parent of the kernel commit) and 845d684f, has zero references to thermite-kernel / x86_64-pc-uefi-smp-v1 / bootable_kernel across 173 files, and writes only fx pure. Scope grew twice during implementation, both recorded on the issue before acting: the fx platform(...) atom and its 12-domain enum had to go (no consumer, and its tests were in the removal set), which cascaded to reverting thermite-verified's ATOM_COUNT from 21 back to 9 and narrowing thermite-lower's effect mask from u32 to u16 - all of which restores exactly the b8dc3947 shape. Gates: cargo build 0, doc-drift 0 with 0 drift after re-pinning 29 co-governing docs, req-registry --check 0 at 508 requirements / 124 views, and cargo test --workspace with an EMPTY set difference of failing test names against the pin. --target kernel is renamed --target freestanding, verified end to end: the new flag emits the rlib, the old flag is a usage error, and fx platform(boot) is a parse error.
